messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up — ran a SmoothQuant + mixed FP8/INT8 pass on the new 64k checkpoint and seeing a weird accuracy dip when kv-cache grows past ~48k. Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking_face:

arun.singh: interesting. is the drop in generation quality (rouge/bleu) or embeddings?

maria.chen: generation. rouge-l drops ~6 points on long-context eval set (64k) vs fp16 baseline. perf numbers look fine otherwise (latency ~+5% token).

jake: can you paste the quant command and eval metrics?

maria.chen: ```
./run_quant.py --model rwinf-13b --quant-backend smoothquant --mix-fp8-int8 --act-aware true --calib-shots 2048 --ctx 65536 --kvcache-mode persistent
# eval: rouge-l: fp16=48.2, mix=42.1, ppl rises 1.15x, emb-sim mean drop 0.006
```

sasha: first guess: activation scale mismatch at some transformer blocks when sequence length scales up. SmoothQuant rescales weights/acts but layerwise clipping might not generalize to 64k if calib set is short.

arun.singh: agree. check per-layer act scale hist. Also try increasing calib-shots to 8k and run with --act-fusion-disable toggle.

maria.chen: ran per-layer stats. noticed layers 18-24 have huge interquartile act variance when ctx>48k. Posting snippet: ```
layer 18 act_scale 0.12 iqr 0.09->0.4 (64k)
layer 22 act_scale 0.08 iqr 0.07->0.35 (64k)
```

jake: that screams activation distribution shift (long-tail heads). Two practical tests: 1) calibs with artificially long prefixes (synthetic repeat tokens) 2) fallback to fp8 on early layers + int8 last ones.

sasha: also try AWQ (activation-aware per-channel quant) and GPTQ for comparison. AWQ sometimes handles heavy activation skew better at cost of slightly more compute.

maria.chen: queued AWQ and GPTQ runs. small heads-up: AWQ + 64k takes ~1.6x calibration time vs SQ.

arun.singh: one more idea — kv-cache decay: verify your kvcache-mode. persistent caches can accumulate uncalibrated representations. Try kvcache-truncate=49152 to see if accuracy stabilizes.

maria.chen: tried truncate=49152 — rouge-l back to 46.7 (closer). So caching seems to expose unhandled activation tails.

jake: good find. long-term fix options: (A) extend calibration dataset with long-context examples; (B) layerwise dynamic clipping during runtime; (C) model-side pre-normalization on kv vectors.

sasha: for deployment profile, we should document a recommended config: if ctx>=48k then use AWQ or SQ+increased-calib + kvcache-truncation. Also track delta metrics per-context length in console.

infra-bot: perf job queued: run-id=run_183000_01, workers=8, priority=high.

maria.chen: thanks — I'll aggregate logs + diff eval and open a small RFC for the rollout gating. TL;DR: SQ+mix-fp8-int8 is viable but needs long-context-aware calibration and kvcache controls; AWQ looks promising as fallback. :thumbsup:
